exam.exam_name: MP Middle School Teacher Selection Test (MSTST)
aliases: MP Middle School Teacher Selection Exam

source_evidence.captured_wording: एमपी ऑनलाइन के निर्धारित प्रारूप पर फोटो (नाम व दिनांक सहित), हस्ताक्षर एवं स्वघोषणा लिखकर 220 KB से कम साइज में स्कैन कर अपलोड करें।
source_evidence.document_title: Middle School Teacher Selection Test Rulebook

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.
dimensions.permitted_pixel_range: Pre-formatted single page scan; max 220 KB JPG; containing photograph (with name and date), signature, and handwritten declaration

unsupported_requirement_reasons: The body requires the candidate's name and/or the photograph date printed on the image. The engine has no text-rendering capability, so the photograph is produced correctly sized and composed but without the imprint, which the candidate must add before uploading.

requirements.content_instructions: JPG, JPEG; Pre-formatted single page scan; max 220 KB JPG; containing photograph (with name and date), signature, and handwritten declaration; A4 single template form; White form background; photo light background; Running handwriting with black pen inside signature box; Validated by MPESB profile engine before selection form unlocks

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.

requirements.requirement_name: MPTET Pass Marksheet (Eligibility Test Qualification Proof)
requirements.content_instructions: PDF, JPG, JPEG; 100 KB to 200 KB legible scan; A4 original marksheet; Candidate must have qualified the MP Middle School Teacher Eligibility Test (TET-2020 or TET-2023) with valid certificate

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Middle School Teacher Selection Test Rulebook - Section 11 (Online Application Instructions) (https://esb.mp.gov.in/rulebooks/mstst_rulebook_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Middle School Teacher Selection Test Rulebook - Section 11 (Online Application Instructions) (https://esb.mp.gov.in/rulebooks/mstst_rulebook_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
